svg.title: web-tools-private
svg.desc: The hub's hexagon with a keyhole for its bore: the private sister that holds what the public page must not. Drawn on the budget-drs app icon's box and rules in one colour, indigo-600 (#4f46e5): solid, no strokes, and every gap at least 2.5 units, which is about 1.4 CSS pixels at 16.
